title: A day in the Dien Bien Phu basin
summary: One day in the Muong Thanh basin: the monument on Hill D1, Hill A1, the museum as its own visit, the bunker, the bridge, and the river. Muong Phang is the next morning.

stops.name: Victory monument and Hill D1
stops.note: Start at the victory monument on Hill D1.

stops.name: Hill A1
stops.note: Walk the hill and the crater, and skip the 11:00 to 13:30 close.

stops.name: Dien Bien Phu Victory Museum
stops.note: See the victory museum as its own visit, separate from the hill.

stops.name: De Castries bunker
stops.note: See the De Castries bunker in the basin.

stops.name: Muong Thanh bridge
stops.note: Cross the Muong Thanh bridge over the Nam Rom.

stops.name: The Nam Rom and the basin fields
stops.note: Walk the basin fields along the river.
